subject: ICT
title: Click, Click
subtitle: Learning to double-click
hero_picture: A kitten peeping out from behind a wooden cupboard door in a green room, a curious girl looking around for it.

sections.heading: Who is hiding?
text: Kuttan the cat is hiding behind the cupboard.
It is fun to find what is hidden.
sections.caption: Kitten behind the cupboard
sections.picture: A kitten hiding behind a half-open wooden cupboard door, only its face peeping out.

sections.heading: Double click
text: A double click is two quick presses: click-click!
Press fast, without moving the mouse.
sections.caption: Double-clicking the mouse
sections.picture: A girl's finger tapping a computer mouse button two times quickly, with two small motion marks.

sections.heading: Blocks on the screen
text: Open the game 'Double tap or Double click'.
Double-click each block to make it go away.
sections.caption: Blocks hiding a picture
sections.picture: A laptop screen showing a wall of plain cream-coloured blocks with part of a bird's wing visible behind them.

sections.heading: The picture appears
text: One by one, the blocks vanish.
Look, a big eagle is flying!
Guess the picture before all the blocks go.
sections.caption: The eagle appears
sections.picture: The same laptop screen with most blocks gone, showing a big eagle flying with spread wings.

sections.heading: Take turns
text: Count how many double clicks you need.
sections.caption: Playing together
sections.picture: Children taking turns at a laptop, one clicking while the others watch excitedly.

rhyme: Two fast taps, that's the trick,
Blocks go away, one, two, three,
A flying eagle I can see!
activity: Play hide and seek with a toy. Hide it under a cloth and let a friend guess what it is.
talk: Who was hiding behind the cupboard?
How is a double click different from a click?
What did you see behind the blocks?
summary: A double click is two quick presses of the mouse button.

questions.prompt: A double click means pressing the button...
questions.explanation: Two quick presses make a double click.

questions.prompt: What should the mouse do during a double click?
questions.explanation: Keep the mouse still while double-clicking.

questions.prompt: What happens to a block when we double-click it?
Who was hiding behind the cupboard?
What was hidden behind the blocks?
questions.explanation: A flying eagle was behind the blocks.
